title: FAQ Grid
description: A 4-column structured grid highlighting key product care symbols, washing temperatures, and ironing guidelines.
heading: Product Care & Spec Grid
subtitle: At-a-glance technical grid for washing, drying, and ironing specifications.

questions.question: Washing Temp: Max 30°C
questions.answer: Wash on gentle delicate wool cycle. Do not exceed 30°C (86°F).

questions.question: Drying: Flat Air Dry
questions.answer: Do not tumble dry. Reshape while damp and lay flat on a clean towel.

questions.question: Ironing: Low Heat Steam
questions.answer: Steam on low heat setting (max 110°C). Use a press cloth over dark fabrics.

questions.question: Bleaching: Do Not Bleach
questions.answer: Avoid chlorine or oxygen-based bleaching agents to prevent fiber degradation.
